sections.text: Global AI Construct · Brisbane · Mon 31 Aug 2026 Small Models, Sharp Jobs. Build a local agent that proves its work. 85 minutes · build along or observe Offline · your runtime, your machine Victorian crash sample · attributed, de-identified Welcome and setup1 / 23

sections.title: Speaker
sections.text: Builder / Speaker / Community contributor Jernej Kavka (JK) Agentic AI, Azure AI, coding-agent workflows, .NET and local models that have to survive a bad Wi-Fi night. GitHubjernejk Webjkdev.me X@jernej_kavka LinkedInjernejkavka City Lead Build Club Brisbane Microsoft AI MVP @SSWConsulting Brisbane, Australia Welcome and setup2 / 23

sections.title: Agenda
sections.text: Audience agenda · 85 minutes A workflow you can see. 0–8Welcome and setupExplain the recovery lane; attendees build or observe.8–16Hello and typed JSONProve a local runtime can answer, then show a no-tool typed contract.16–30GatherFilter the approved crash sample by date, term and cap. Show a supported and no-evidence result.30–45ExtractSend the question and compact pack only. Inspect selected IDs, rationale and confidence.45–57AnalyseSend only code-validated selected records.57–68Gates and workflowShow invalid IDs and low confidence stopping safely; run the identical linear workflow.68–77Recovery and checkpointsPairing, saved Gather output, or a checkpoint solution.77–85Close and hidden extrasModel comparison, MCP and Harness only if time remains.Welcome and setup3 / 23

sections.title: Build or observe
sections.text: Before anything runs Build along, or observe. Both work. dotnet test dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- gather --term intersection BuildersStart in starter/Your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint: MAF_ENDPOINT, MAF_MODEL, MAF_API_KEY. ObserversNo setup requiredEvery checkpoint has a saved run on screen. You still see the whole trust boundary. StuckFive minutes, then movePair up, copy the stage from solution/, or watch. Do not debug in public. Welcome and setup4 / 23

sections.title: The core sequence
sections.text: The whole workshop on one slide Smaller context. Sharper work. Gather→ Extract→ gate→ Analyse→ gate Deterministic Gather narrows the corpus. Extract turns a question plus a capped pack into typed record IDs. Code validates before Analyse ever runs. Teal steps are ordinary C# — no model gets a vote there. Welcome and setup5 / 23

sections.title: Up next: Hello and typed JSON
sections.text: Up next Prove the lane, then give it a contract. A successful hello is a checkpoint, not a product. minutes 8–16 02Hello and typed JSON6 / 23

sections.title: CP-01 Local hello
sections.text: CP-01 · Local hello One prompt. One answer. No tools. MAF_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:1234/v1 MAF_MODEL=<the model you already have loaded> MAF_API_KEY=<only if your runtime demands one> dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- smoke Acceptance smoke echoes the exact token; a down endpoint or unloaded model exits non-zero. Hello and typed JSON7 / 23

sections.title: CP-02 Typed JSON
sections.text: CP-02 · Typed JSON Useful output needs a shape. dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- typed ModelReturns a small typed contractA handful of fields. Not prose, not a tool call. CodeParses and validates itMalformed output is rejected here, never quietly accepted. BoundaryNo tools in this callThe local path deliberately does not combine tools and typed JSON. Acceptance typed prints raw JSON then the parsed contract; malformed output exits non-zero. Hello and typed JSON8 / 23

sections.title: Up next: Gather
sections.text: Up next Evidence first. Reason later. The first real job is not a model call at all. minutes 16–30 03Gather9 / 23

sections.title: CP-03 Gather
sections.text: CP-03 · Gather A bounded query, not arbitrary files. dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- gather --term intersection dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- gather --term cyclist # the second command is the no-evidence branch Acceptance Code filters the approved crash sample by date, term and cap — then a query that returns nothing. Gather10 / 23

sections.title: What Gather may not do
sections.text: Why this stays deterministic The model may ask. It may not reach. MayDate, term, capThree parameters over one approved Victorian crash sample. May notName a pathNo filesystem, no folder listing, no unbounded result set. ResultA compact packCapped, attributed records — the pack goes forward, the dataset does not. Recovery workshop/reference-run/gather-intersection.json is the expected pack if a machine is not ready. Gather11 / 23

sections.title: Up next: Extract
sections.text: Up next Ask the model to select, not to conclude. Question plus capped pack in. Typed record IDs out. minutes 30–45 04Extract12 / 23

sections.title: CP-04 Extract
sections.text: CP-04 · Extract Selected IDs, rationale, confidence. dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- run --term intersection extract JSON: { "selectedIds": [...], "confidence": 0.0-1.0 } Acceptance Unknown IDs, duplicate IDs and malformed output are rejected in code — not argued with in the prompt. Extract13 / 23

sections.title: Up next: Analyse
sections.text: Up next High effort on a small set. Only records that already passed the gate get analysed. minutes 45–57 05Analyse14 / 23

sections.title: CP-05 Analyse
sections.text: CP-05 · Analyse Only validated records reach this call. InCode-validated selectionThe compact set Extract chose and validation accepted. Nothing else. EffortHighest of the threeLow effort finds candidates; medium structures them; high explains the small set. OutA grounded findingFormatted deterministically for an analyst — never a claim decision. Acceptance Low confidence takes the caution branch instead of producing a confident answer. Analyse15 / 23

sections.title: Up next: Gates and workflow
sections.text: Up next The model proposes. Code decides. Then the identical sequence, as a reusable workflow. minutes 57–68 06Gates and workflow16 / 23

sections.title: Code-owned gates
sections.text: Three visible outcomes Every branch is a success. No evidenceStop earlyGather returned nothing. Extract and Analyse never run. Invalid or low confidenceCaution resultUnknown ID, malformed JSON, or confidence under the threshold. SupportedGrounded analysisValidated records, an explained finding, and the evidence still on screen. Acceptance Invalid IDs and low confidence stop safely — a refusal is a correct answer. Gates and workflow17 / 23

sections.title: CP-06 Workflow
sections.text: CP-06 · Workflow Same sequence. Visible topology. dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- run --term intersection dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- workflow --term intersection # explicit calls, then the same sequence as one reusable workflow Acceptance No evidence bypasses Extract and Analyse. The workflow adds reuse and topology, not intelligence. Gates and workflow18 / 23

sections.title: Up next: Recovery and checkpoints
sections.text: Up next Catch up without catching fire. Pairing, saved output, or a checkpoint solution. minutes 68–77 07Recovery and checkpoints19 / 23

sections.title: Recovery lanes
sections.text: Pick a lane and rejoin Three ways back into the room. PairSit with a working machineOne laptop per pair is enough to hit every checkpoint. Saved outputUse the reference runworkshop/reference-run/gather-intersection.json is the real bounded pack. Solution treeCopy one stagesolution/ is the explicit catch-up state. Take the stage, rejoin at the next handoff. Note A hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint is participant-owned and optional. Never share a facilitator key. Recovery and checkpoints20 / 23

sections.title: Up next: Close and hidden extras
sections.text: Up next Close and hidden extras. Model comparison, MCP and Harness only if time remains. minutes 77–85 08Close and hidden extras21 / 23

sections.title: Evergreen note
sections.text: The part that outlives the model Teach the boundary, not the benchmark. Models change every few months. Constrained inputs, reduced context, validated output and a real recovery path do not. The model proposes; code decides — that sentence still holds when tonight's model is three generations old. Close and hidden extras22 / 23

sections.title: Thank you
sections.text: Thank you Small jobs. Clear evidence. Provable outcomes. What would make this easier to follow, or safer to reuse on Monday? Slides and checkpoints small-models-sharp-jobs-workshop-20260829.surge.sh/slides/ Deck, agenda, commands and the saved reference run. Close and hidden extras23 / 23

sections.title: Extra: Workflow vs Harness
sections.text: Presenter extra Workflow versus Harness. A workflow is fixed and code-owned: the safe sequence is already known. A Harness packages a model-directed loop — planning, session state, compaction, approvals, recovery and stopping. Write one by hand and you own all of those. A Harness earns its keep when the investigation is genuinely open-ended. Close and hidden extraspresenter extra

sections.title: Extra: MCP
sections.text: Presenter extra MCP is the tool plug. MCP and function tools expose capability. They do not decide when to stop, what to trust, or what the controller is allowed to see. Keep tool output constrained if the controller should never see raw evidence. Close and hidden extraspresenter extra

sections.title: Extra: Benchmarks
sections.text: Presenter extra Benchmark only what you rehearse. 4B is the official attendee lane. Tonight's rehearsal ran about 5 seconds on the reference Mac (nvidia-nemotron-3-nano-4b in LM Studio). Any other number needs its own run on that hardware and runtime — quoting anything else is borrowing someone else's machine. Close and hidden extraspresenter extra

sections.title: Extra: Hosted access
sections.text: Presenter extra Hosted access stays optional. Participant-owned provider only. Costs and availability are theirs. Rehearse tools and structured output before assuming any free route is compatible. Close and hidden extraspresenter extra

rows.text: Deterministic Gather narrows the corpus. Extract turns a question plus a capped pack into typed record IDs. Code validates before Analyse ever runs. Teal steps are ordinary C# — no model gets a vote there.

rows.title: Up next: Hello and typed JSON
rows.text: A successful hello is a checkpoint, not a product.

rows.title: Up next: Gather
rows.text: The first real job is not a model call at all.

rows.title: Up next: Extract
rows.text: Question plus capped pack in. Typed record IDs out.

rows.title: Up next: Analyse
rows.text: Only records that already passed the gate get analysed.

rows.title: Up next: Gates and workflow
rows.text: Then the identical sequence, as a reusable workflow.

rows.title: Up next: Recovery and checkpoints
rows.text: Pairing, saved output, or a checkpoint solution.

rows.title: Up next: Close and hidden extras
rows.text: Model comparison, MCP and Harness only if time remains.

rows.title: Evergreen note
rows.text: Models change every few months. Constrained inputs, reduced context, validated output and a real recovery path do not. The model proposes; code decides — that sentence still holds when tonight's model is three generations old.

rows.title: Thank you
rows.text: What would make this easier to follow, or safer to reuse on Monday?

rows.title: Extra: Workflow vs Harness
rows.text: A workflow is fixed and code-owned: the safe sequence is already known. A Harness packages a model-directed loop — planning, session state, compaction, approvals, recovery and stopping. Write one by hand and you own all of those. A Harness earns its keep when the investigation is genuinely open-ended.

rows.title: Extra: MCP
rows.text: MCP and function tools expose capability. They do not decide when to stop, what to trust, or what the controller is allowed to see. Keep tool output constrained if the controller should never see raw evidence.

rows.title: Extra: Benchmarks
rows.text: 4B is the official attendee lane. Tonight's rehearsal ran about 5 seconds on the reference Mac (nvidia-nemotron-3-nano-4b in LM Studio). Any other number needs its own run on that hardware and runtime — quoting anything else is borrowing someone else's machine.

rows.title: Extra: Hosted access
rows.text: Participant-owned provider only. Costs and availability are theirs. Rehearse tools and structured output before assuming any free route is compatible.

sections.title: CP-01 Local hello
sections.text: CP-01 · Local hello One prompt. One answer. No tools. MAF_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:1234/v1 MAF_MODEL=<the model you already have loaded> MAF_API_KEY=<only if your runtime demands one> dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- smoke Acceptance smoke echoes the exact token; a down endpoint or unloaded model exits non-zero. Hello and typed JSON7 / 23

sections.title: CP-02 Typed JSON
sections.text: CP-02 · Typed JSON Useful output needs a shape. dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- typed ModelReturns a small typed contractA handful of fields. Not prose, not a tool call. CodeParses and validates itMalformed output is rejected here, never quietly accepted. BoundaryNo tools in this callThe local path deliberately does not combine tools and typed JSON. Acceptance typed prints raw JSON then the parsed contract; malformed output exits non-zero. Hello and typed JSON8 / 23

sections.title: CP-03 Gather
sections.text: CP-03 · Gather A bounded query, not arbitrary files. dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- gather --term intersection dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- gather --term cyclist # the second command is the no-evidence branch Acceptance Code filters the approved crash sample by date, term and cap — then a query that returns nothing. Gather10 / 23

sections.title: What Gather may not do
sections.text: Why this stays deterministic The model may ask. It may not reach. MayDate, term, capThree parameters over one approved Victorian crash sample. May notName a pathNo filesystem, no folder listing, no unbounded result set. ResultA compact packCapped, attributed records — the pack goes forward, the dataset does not. Recovery workshop/reference-run/gather-intersection.json is the expected pack if a machine is not ready. Gather11 / 23

sections.title: CP-04 Extract
sections.text: CP-04 · Extract Selected IDs, rationale, confidence. dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- run --term intersection extract JSON: { "selectedIds": [...], "confidence": 0.0-1.0 } Acceptance Unknown IDs, duplicate IDs and malformed output are rejected in code — not argued with in the prompt. Extract13 / 23

sections.title: CP-05 Analyse
sections.text: CP-05 · Analyse Only validated records reach this call. InCode-validated selectionThe compact set Extract chose and validation accepted. Nothing else. EffortHighest of the threeLow effort finds candidates; medium structures them; high explains the small set. OutA grounded findingFormatted deterministically for an analyst — never a claim decision. Acceptance Low confidence takes the caution branch instead of producing a confident answer. Analyse15 / 23

sections.title: Code-owned gates
sections.text: Three visible outcomes Every branch is a success. No evidenceStop earlyGather returned nothing. Extract and Analyse never run. Invalid or low confidenceCaution resultUnknown ID, malformed JSON, or confidence under the threshold. SupportedGrounded analysisValidated records, an explained finding, and the evidence still on screen. Acceptance Invalid IDs and low confidence stop safely — a refusal is a correct answer. Gates and workflow17 / 23

sections.title: CP-06 Workflow
sections.text: CP-06 · Workflow Same sequence. Visible topology. dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- run --term intersection dotnet run --project src/Workshop.App -- workflow --term intersection # explicit calls, then the same sequence as one reusable workflow Acceptance No evidence bypasses Extract and Analyse. The workflow adds reuse and topology, not intelligence. Gates and workflow18 / 23
